svg.text: Concept 4 — Gothic lantern with cat windows
Eight-sided lantern with pointed-arch windows; a sitting cat is cut out of each big window. The roof is the cat's head and lifts off.
All dimensions in mm · concept sketch, not final geometry
access: lift the roof cap off (seat at z 128, opening Ø133)
fits Ø150 ≤ Ø160 · no supports needed
